about:
Café Athena (also written Cafe Athena) has been serving Greek food at 1846 Garnet Ave in Pacific Beach, San Diego, since 1990. Locals in PB and visitors to the neighbourhood come to us for lunch, dinner and an easygoing happy hour. Our cooking is Greek, and some guests also describe it as Mediterranean. The menu includes gluten-free and vegan options, so mixed tables can eat together. [OWNER TO CONFIRM: a sentence on the restaurant's story or signature dishes, if you'd like one included]

We have a full bar with cocktails, and happy hour runs daily from 3 to 6pm. We welcome groups, host private events and offer catering, whether you're planning a birthday dinner on Garnet Ave or feeding a crowd elsewhere in San Diego. We're open Sunday to Thursday 11am–9pm and Friday to Saturday 11am–9:30pm. If you have a food allergy, please talk with our team before you order.
